title: BreakRL: Reinforcement Learning Fundamentals
description: An ablation-driven reinforcement learning textbook available in Chinese and English. Each of the 14 chapters pairs a written derivation (PDF) with reproducible experiments in which key mechanisms are removed so readers can watch the algorithm fail. Covers bandits, MDPs, temporal-difference learning, DQN, policy gradients, Actor-Critic, PPO, SAC, offline RL (CQL/IQL), model-based RL (Dyna-Q), Decision Transformer, and the LLM post-training trilogy (RLHF, DPO, GRPO/RLVR), plus a 17-entry failure atlas organized as symptom, mechanism, reproduction, and fix. Text is CC BY 4.0; notebook code is MIT.
